decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core cheese range that survived the initial post-launch shakeout, it benefits from commitment to the existing organic dairy portfolio and any weaker results can still be explained as temporary market variation.

Although the spicy variant is somewhat more niche and therefore more vulnerable than a plain core cheese, management is still likely to continue because it has already invested in and publicly presented the product as part of the cheese line.
This soft cheese received explicit launch emphasis and a dedicated presentation, so sunk costs and visible commitment make the firm more likely to retain it unless results become clearly poor.
